class.name: TurboData
class.brief_description: Authoring data for the optional, load-driven turbocharger model.
class.description: TurboData configures the value-owned turbo state used by a vehicle engine. Values are authored within their Inspector ranges and supplied through a valid resource/configuration; Turbo::update assumes a positive physics timestep from its caller. Configuration copies the three properties directly. The runtime keeps normalized shaft energy and delivered boost as separate states. Shaft energy is driven by effective throttle, normalized base-engine torque, and engine RPM relative to [member full_boost_rpm]. The compressor target is [member max_boost_bar] multiplied by squared shaft energy; delivered boost is then approached independently, vents rapidly on lift, and feeds the engine air-charge ratio. Exponential transitions remain stable across physics timesteps. A vehicle without turbo data remains naturally aspirated.

members.member: Maximum delivered boost pressure above atmospheric pressure, in bar.
Engine speed in RPM at which the normalized RPM contribution to turbo shaft energy reaches 1.0.
Base exponential time constant, in seconds, for shaft-energy response; shaft decay on lift uses twice this lag.
